parameters.label: Audio Encoding
parameters.helpText: Runtime value available as query $var "encoding" and request $path "config.audio.encoding".
parameters.errorMessage: Please select a valid audio encoding for custom TTS.

parameters.label: Sample Rate
parameters.helpText: Runtime value available as query $var "sample_rate" and request $path "config.audio.sample_rate".
parameters.errorMessage: Please select a valid sample rate for custom TTS.

parameters.label: Query Parameters
parameters.helpText: Optional flat JSON object for websocket query params. Supported $var values: message_id, voice_id, model, language, encoding, sample_rate. Values must resolve to strings, numbers, or booleans. $cast supports string, number, and boolean.
parameters.errorMessage: Please provide valid query parameters for custom TTS.

parameters.label: Request Rules
parameters.helpText: Required ordered websocket outbound rules. Must include at least one text packet rule. when.packet supports text, done, interrupt. send.frame supports binary, json, text. Supported $path values include config.voice.id, config.model, config.language, config.audio.encoding, config.audio.sample_rate, packet.kind, packet.message_id, and packet.text. $cast supports string, number, and boolean.
parameters.errorMessage: Please provide valid request rules for custom TTS.

parameters.label: Response Rules
parameters.helpText: Required websocket response rules. when.frame supports binary and json. Emit keys: audio, message_id, done, error. Use $path for JSON payload values, $frame "binary" for binary audio, optional $decode "base64" for encoded audio, and optional $cast for primitive conversion.
parameters.errorMessage: Please provide valid response rules for custom TTS.
